plugins.description: The six framework skills (creator, modify, importer, operator, walk-verify, connect) plus the CLI conventions. Requires the CLIs `agent-app` and `a2app`: once published, `npm i -g agent-app`; from a cloned source tree (v0.1), `pnpm -r build` then `npm link` in `framework/cli`.
